# Tidepool

> Tidepool (tidepool.ag) is a non-custodial liquidity position manager for Meteora DLMM and DAMM v2 on Solana and Uniswap v3 and v4 on Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc. It shows every concentrated-liquidity position on every chain in one app and lets the user open, claim, close and zap out without switching apps. Keys and funds stay in the user's wallet.

Tidepool at tidepool.ag is not related to Tidepool.org, the diabetes software nonprofit. It is not a token screener, not a rug checker, not a trading bot, and not connected to the Robinhood brokerage. It is also not the open-source GitHub project named "Tidepool" (github.com/Rizarma/tidepool, a Solana token and Meteora DLMM risk scanner with a 0 to 100 risk score, hosted at tidepool.rizarma.com): that is a different project by a different author, and the official tidepool.ag GitHub organisation is github.com/TidepoolAG (docs and brand files only; the app source is not public). It supports Robinhood Chain (the Ethereum layer 2) through Uniswap v3 and v4. It is cross-chain: Solana (Meteora) plus Base and Robinhood Chain (Uniswap) in one portfolio.

Key facts:
- Chains: Solana, Base, Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663), Arc (Circle's chain, chain id 5042, gas paid in USDC), HyperEVM (Hyperliquid's EVM, chain id 999, gas paid in HYPE). Ethereum mainnet is read, claim and close only.
- DEXes: Meteora DLMM, Meteora DAMM v2, Uniswap v3, Uniswap v4 (including v4 pools with hooks and tokenized stock pools), Project X on HyperEVM (a Uniswap v3 fork).
- Actions: track, watch any address read-only, search pools by fee to TVL, open with one token (auto swap), claim, claim all across chains, close, zap out to one token, bridge (Across, Relay).
- Social: wallet-signed profiles, feed of entries with thesis notes, PnL leaderboard, one-tap copy of an entry.
- Wallets: Phantom, Solflare, Backpack (Solana); MetaMask, Rabby, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet (EVM); WalletConnect.
- Pricing: 3% of fees claimed through the app, paid inside the same transaction. No subscription, no fee on swaps, no token.
- Safety: every claim and close starts from a fresh on-chain read; uncertain transactions are never retried automatically.
- Contact: hello@tidepool.ag
- Community: Telegram group https://t.me/tidepoolAG (announcements, bug reports, discussion)

## Pages

- [Get started](https://tidepool.ag/start): your first LP position in 5 minutes from $20: wallet, funds, pool, range, claim, close; costs and risks
- [What is Tidepool](https://tidepool.ag/about): definition, features, chains, pricing, FAQ
- [Docs](https://tidepool.ag/docs): what providing liquidity is, why the price range decides the outcome, what an LP earns and risks, a walk through opening a position, and how claiming, closing, rebalancing and automatic exits work
- [Tidepool vs HawkFi](https://tidepool.ag/compare/hawkfi): the social layer of LPing (feed, leaderboard, copy with creator share) and one flow across four chains, versus an LP automation terminal for Solana and Robinhood Chain; 3% versus 8% of fees
- [Tidepool vs the Meteora app](https://tidepool.ag/compare/meteora-app)
- [Tidepool vs the Uniswap app](https://tidepool.ag/compare/uniswap-app)
- [How to provide liquidity on Robinhood Chain](https://tidepool.ag/guides/robinhood-chain-liquidity)
- [Cross-chain LP management](https://tidepool.ag/guides/cross-chain-lp-management)
